title: Integrar barrera de contención verificada al protocolo binding
mission: Independently verify the committed contention barrier test plus the real two-worker GitHub canary, then integrate the smallest authority-safe barrier/rendezvous contract into binding worker/portfolio allocation protocol. Entrant and RELEASE receipts must remain timing-only; normal portfolio jobs must remain unchanged; barrier mode must be explicit to multi-party canary jobs. Also bind a Live projection contract for waiting/released/winner/collision/timeout states. Do not promote production /w.
definition_of_done: Independent replay of coordination/portfolio/tests/contention_start_barrier_v1.mjs passes from the committed blob.
Real canary evidence proves two distinct entrants, no-authority RELEASE, one deterministic pin winner, one matching claim, one genuine loser collision receipt and no loser claim.
Binding protocol changes are surgical and explicitly preserve PORTFOLIO_PIN_PROTOCOL authority: entrant/RELEASE never grant execution authority.
Barrier/rendezvous mode is opt-in for explicit multi-party contention fixtures; ordinary portfolio allocation does not wait on barriers.
Timeout semantics guarantee no pin attempt before quorum and re-entry instead of deadlock.
Live projection contract defines WAITING_FOR_CONTENDERS, RELEASED_TO_RACE, winner, collision loser and timeout without overriding durable evidence.
Tests or validation evidence cover backward compatibility with normal deterministic pin races.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w promotion is inferred.
